services.name: kayak or paddleboard
services.desc: With an incredible variety of on-the-water adventures and island fun to choose from, finding the perfect activity is all part of the excitement. The waters of Broad Creek are a great spot to explore via kayak or stand-up paddleboard. Look for dolphins, birds and even the occasional otter and manatee as you navigate our Hilton Head, SC waters with your kayak or paddleboard rental. Craft your own on the water adventure! Outside Hilton Head has a fleet of safe and comfortable boards and kayaks that you can rent to enjoy the Broad Creek waterway. Hourly rentals are available daily at Shelter Cove Marina. Hourly rentals are available on a first-come, first-served basis. Discover Hilton Head

services.name: boat tour
services.desc: With an incredible variety of on-the-water adventures and island fun to choose from, finding the perfect activity is all part of the excitement. Nature cruises are the best way to enjoy the South Carolina lowcountry waterways. Off our shores, you’ll have the chance to see egrets, herons, osprey, bald eagles, pelicans, bottlenose dolphins, and maybe even sharks. Set sail for an unforgettable evening on the water with Outside Hilton Head’s Lowcountry Boil Dinner Cruise. Enjoy a classic Lowcountry feast-shrimp, sausage, corn, and potatoes-served hot and fresh aboard our comfortable cruise vessel. services.name: Rent a pontoon boat
services.desc: With an incredible variety of on-the-water adventures and island fun to choose from, finding the perfect activity is all part of the excitement. Shelter Cove Marina has luxury pontoon boat rentals. Our boats are the perfect way for you to get out on the water with family and friends for an enjoyable and relaxing day on Hilton Head Island. Save 10% when reserving 20+ days in advance in 2026. Use code BOOKAHEAD when making a reservation. Our spacious luxury rental boats allow up to 12 people to enjoy the experience together. blurb: Guests can dock boats of various sizes, rent kayaks and paddleboards, join guided kayak and paddleboard tours, take dolphin watching cruises, and book luxury yacht charters including sunset and fireworks cruises. Kayak tours include nature, fishing, and special event paddles. Dolphin tours range from small boat trips to large cruise ships with narrated experiences.
